title: Q4 Private Instance Activation Playlist and Capacity Gating (cohort-driven rollouts)
creator: Priya Rao
description: Create an end-to-end activation playlist for Q4 that sequences private/VPC/on-prem feature gates, capacity checks, and customer cohort activations. This ticket defines the cadence, OKR mappings, preflight checks, fallback behaviors, and dashboards needed to safely activate isolated instances at scale. The goal is a repeatable playbook that reduces manual coordination, shortens time-to-activate, and keeps SLOs stable across activations.
acceptance_criteria: A consolidated activation checklist exists and is versioned in Confluence with templates for small/medium/large customers
Three activation cohorts defined (Pilot, Wave A, Wave B) with clear capacity and compatibility gates
Dashboard panels in Console showing activation progress, per-tenant latency p50/p95, request-failure rates, and token cost delta
Canary rollback and automatic fallback to hosted models implemented for 95% of activation flows
Post-activation incident and cost review template created and scheduled for each cohort
milestones: Nov 10: Finalize cohort definitions and acceptance gates
Nov 18: Run first dry-run activation in staging with synthetic traffic
Nov 25: Instrument Console dashboards and alert thresholds
Dec 12: Wave A activation (20-30 tenants) contingent on pilot signals
Dec 20: Wave B gradual ramp to remaining consenting tenants
notes: This task synthesizes learnings from prior isolated-deploy activations and the runtime autoscaling pilot. Plan to include a short checklist for legal/compliance signoff for regulated tenants. Coordinate with Sales to build a small activation calendar that matches customer availability windows. Keep rollback window for each cohort at least 48 hours after initial activation. Consider a dark-launch of audit logging to validate KMS/HSM integrations before wider activation.
risks: Unexpected KV cache pressure causing tail latency spikes during cohort ramp
Capacity contention in dedicated clusters if autoscaling policies are too conservative
Customer configuration mismatches for on-prem networking leading to failed activations
Compliance signoffs delayed for regulated tenants
Cost regression if quantization falls back to larger model variants without approvals
